title: What cannot be tested, and the record that would allow it
question: Which drawings, lists and pools publish too little to test for repeat winners, and what record would be enough?
finding: 25 of the 37 systems cannot be tested for repeat winners from what is published: 12 publish nothing usable, 2 publish counts or the entrant pool only, 6 publish winners without applicants, 2 publish ticket numbers that change every drawing, and 3 publish pool spending without the task orders. The download also recorded 173 links it could not fetch.
how: Every inventory row that does not publish both entrants and winners is listed with the one record that would make a test possible. The wording of the request is this project’s; the publisher’s note is the inventory’s. Links the download could not fetch are counted from its own log.
limits: Asking for a record is not a claim that anything is wrong. For housing, shelter, school and benefit lists the entrants are private individuals, and the request is for anonymous numbers that stay the same across drawings, never names. Some of these records may exist on pages the download did not reach: of the 173 links not fetched, 62 were files on Google Drive that the site’s robots rules bar from automatic download, 44 were dead links, 40 were files set aside after download as outside the subject, 27 were pages that refused the request or bar automatic download.
